families.title: 学 family
families.shortDescription: Words connected to studying and learning.
families.meaningNote: 学 often points toward learning, study, or a place connected with education.

families.title: 电 family
families.shortDescription: Everyday words related to electricity and modern life.
families.meaningNote: 电 is a useful visual anchor for familiar words about powered devices and communication.

families.title: 人 family
families.shortDescription: People words that make everyday descriptions more specific.
families.meaningNote: 人 names a person or people, and the character becomes a clear anchor in many descriptions of people.

families.title: 看 family
families.shortDescription: A verb family for looking, watching, and seeing.
families.meaningNote: 看 starts with the act of looking; the surrounding character changes what kind of looking is meant.

families.title: 好 family
families.shortDescription: Words that grow from goodness, ease, and a warm welcome.
families.meaningNote: 好 carries the feeling of good or well, then shifts naturally into greetings, taste, appearance, and ability.

families.title: 家 family
families.shortDescription: Everyday words for home, family, and belonging.
families.meaningNote: 家 starts with a home, then opens into the people, places, and ideas connected to it.

families.title: 小 family
families.shortDescription: Small words for children, care, and everyday details.
families.meaningNote: 小 means small or little, and often makes a familiar thing feel more specific or personal.

families.title: 水 family
families.shortDescription: Useful words that flow from water into daily life.
families.meaningNote: 水 is a concrete anchor: it appears in food, objects, levels, and the small routines around drinking.

families.title: 吃 family
families.shortDescription: Words for eating, meals, and small tastes of daily life.
families.meaningNote: 吃 begins with eating, then opens into meals, ingredients, medicine, and the snacks around them.

families.title: 去 family
families.shortDescription: Movement words for leaving, entering, and going back.
families.meaningNote: 去 points away from here; the surrounding character tells us when, where, or how that movement happens.

families.title: 上 family
families.shortDescription: Words for going up, showing up, and the first half of the day.
families.meaningNote: 上 can point upward, toward a place, or toward an activity such as work, school, or class.

families.title: 下 family
families.shortDescription: Words for going down, finishing, and the afternoon.
families.meaningNote: 下 moves downward or toward an ending, from finishing class to the rain falling outside.

families.title: 开 family
families.shortDescription: Words for opening, starting, and making something happen.
families.meaningNote: 开 turns something from closed or paused into open, active, or underway.

families.title: 来 family
families.shortDescription: Movement words for coming in, out, back, and toward a place.
families.meaningNote: 来 moves toward the speaker or a shared point, and combines naturally with direction and return.

families.title: 说 family
families.shortDescription: Words for speaking, explaining, and putting an idea into words.
families.meaningNote: 说 starts with speaking, then expands into explanations, opinions, stories, and conversation.

families.title: 见 family
families.shortDescription: Words for seeing, meeting, and saying goodbye.
families.meaningNote: 见 is the visual anchor for seeing and meeting, from a first hello to a final goodbye.

families.title: 喝 family
families.shortDescription: Everyday drink words, from water to coffee.
families.meaningNote: 喝 begins with the simple action of drinking and opens into drinks, taste, and shared routines.

families.title: 买 family
families.shortDescription: Useful words for buying things and paying for daily life.
families.meaningNote: 买 points to choosing and getting something, from food and books to tickets and a final bill.

families.title: 做 family
families.shortDescription: Action words for making, doing, and getting things done.
families.meaningNote: 做 turns an intention into an action: making food, doing work, or completing something well.

families.title: 有 family
families.shortDescription: Simple words for having, noticing, and describing what exists.
families.meaningNote: 有 starts with having and naturally expands into presence, usefulness, and what is still there.

families.title: 在 family
families.shortDescription: Location words for being here, there, or at home.
families.meaningNote: 在 anchors a place in the sentence, making a person, object, or moment feel present and specific.

families.title: 住 family
families.shortDescription: Home and residence words for saying where life happens.
families.meaningNote: 住 is about staying in a place, then expands into homes, addresses, and the people who live there.

families.title: 要 family
families.shortDescription: Words for wanting, needing, and making a small request.
families.meaningNote: 要 expresses a want or need, then shifts naturally into choices, requests, and what matters most.

families.title: 给 family
families.shortDescription: Giving and receiving words for everyday exchanges.
families.meaningNote: 给 connects a giver, a receiver, and a thing being passed along in one compact, useful pattern.

families.title: 会 family
families.shortDescription: Ability words for knowing how and asking what someone can do.
families.meaningNote: 会 describes a learned ability and opens into speaking, writing, making, and checking what is possible.

families.title: 边 family
families.shortDescription: Location words for saying what is beside, left, or right.
families.meaningNote: 边 points to a side or edge; these compounds help place one thing in relation to another.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 时 family
families.shortDescription: Everyday time words for talking about hours and available time.
families.meaningNote: 时 keeps time concrete: a period, an hour, or the time someone has available.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 生 family
families.shortDescription: Useful life and health words for ordinary daily conversations.
families.meaningNote: 生 connects to life and birth, then becomes practical in health and birthday vocabulary.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 手 family
families.shortDescription: Familiar hand and personal-device words.
families.meaningNote: 手 gives a concrete anchor for objects held or worn in everyday life.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 问 family
families.shortDescription: Questions and asking words for getting information clearly.
families.meaningNote: 问 starts with the action of asking and opens naturally into the questions we ask.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 游 family
families.shortDescription: Movement and leisure words for travel and swimming.
families.meaningNote: 游 carries a sense of moving freely, whether through a trip or through water.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 公 family
families.shortDescription: Public-life words for buses, companies, and everyday quantities.
families.meaningNote: 公 appears in practical public and shared-life vocabulary, from transport to work and shopping.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 上 family
families.shortDescription: Daily schedule words for work and the morning or evening.
families.meaningNote: 上 turns a simple direction into a daily routine: going to work, then talking about when the day begins or ends.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 人 family
families.shortDescription: Everyday people words for describing who someone is.
families.meaningNote: 人 keeps the focus on people while the first character adds a simple social distinction.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 可 family
families.shortDescription: Practical words for possibility, permission, and what someone can do.
families.meaningNote: 可 opens a useful question: is something possible, or is someone allowed and able to do it?
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 快 family
families.shortDescription: Words that move quickly and express a happy feeling.
families.meaningNote: 快 starts with speed and becomes a warm everyday expression in 快乐, happy.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 起 family
families.shortDescription: Useful routine words for getting up and doing things together.
families.meaningNote: 起 anchors a small movement from stillness into action, from getting up to joining someone together.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 车 family
families.shortDescription: Transport words for public buses and personal bicycles.
families.meaningNote: 车 is a concrete transport anchor, moving from a shared city bus to a bicycle someone owns.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 2 family; its core HSK 2 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 2 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 关 family
families.shortDescription: Relationship and attention words for everyday communication.
families.meaningNote: 关 connects closing something with caring about a person or topic.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 一 family
families.shortDescription: Small quantity and sequence phrases for daily speech.
families.meaningNote: 一 expands into compact phrases about one time, one side, and a shared amount.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 地 family
families.shortDescription: Place and location words for moving through a city.
families.meaningNote: 地 anchors places, routes, and the ground beneath everyday movement.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 以 family
families.shortDescription: Time and framing phrases for connecting ideas.
families.meaningNote: 以 helps frame when something happened and how one idea is understood.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 比 family
families.shortDescription: Comparison words for describing differences and examples.
families.meaningNote: 比 turns a simple observation into a comparison, contest, or example.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 表 family
families.shortDescription: Words for expressing, performing, and showing an outer form.
families.meaningNote: 表 moves from expressing an idea to performing it and showing how something looks.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 同 family
families.shortDescription: Words for shared identity, agreement, and togetherness.
families.meaningNote: 同 keeps a sense of sameness or shared connection across people and moments.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 洗 family
families.shortDescription: Practical washing words for home and personal routines.
families.meaningNote: 洗 links everyday cleaning actions with body and household routines.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 照 family
families.shortDescription: Words for care, photographs, and looking closely.
families.meaningNote: 照 can point to caring for someone, shining on something, or making a photograph.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 物 family
families.shortDescription: Concrete thing words for people, gifts, and everyday objects.
families.meaningNote: 物 keeps attention on a thing, whether it is an animal, a gift, or an object.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 结 family
families.shortDescription: Words for ending, marrying, and bringing something to a close.
families.meaningNote: 结 gathers ideas of tying together, ending, and reaching a result.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.

families.title: 现 family
families.shortDescription: Words for appearing, discovering, and what is present.
families.meaningNote: 现 makes something visible, whether it appears, is discovered, or exists in the present.
families.contentNotes: Dedicated HSK 3 family; its core HSK 3 members are verified in the HSK 2.0 exclusive Level 3 list, with Related extensions for a complete five-word map.
